confidence_notes: Holistic model estimates from general knowledge, not checked against live listings or menus. Alcohol prices are the least certain because licensing and tourist-zone markups vary widely. Hostel and hotel rates are seasonal and sensitive to July demand. The FX value comes from the RBA exchange rates overview figure reported in search results for 15 October 2026; I did not open the RBA page directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on regional knowledge of North African and Mediterranean tourist cities with similar mixes of riad and guesthouse lodging and licensed-restaurant pricing. No named source or comparable city price table was used.
